Priya M.: Heads up - proposing promotion for Taylor from IC-3 -> IC-4 (Senior SWE) with effective 2025-06-01. Need clarity on band uplift, equity top-up rules, and whether PTO accruals / benefits change affect pro-rated comp.
Derek S.: Congrats Taylor! We need: proposed base, final band number, equity ask (one-time refresh vs scheduled), and manager sign-off. Is this internal transfer across states?
Priya M.: Base proposed $145k. Current band 4 moving to band 5. Equity request: one-time refresh ~3% to align with peers. No relocation - staying in CA payroll.
Lena R.: Quick checklist: 1) Promotion form + manager rationale, 2) Calibration note if above midpoint, 3) Peer comp check, 4) Equity memo for compops. If moving band, compops needs justification for bump.
Priya M.: Does PRORATE apply to sign-on/bonus? Taylor has a retention lump sum scheduled next month; will promotion affect that payment?
compops-bot: FYI - Promotions that change base salary require compops approval. One-time equity refresh >2.5% triggers exec level review. Payroll cutoff for June payroll is 2025-05-23 17:00 PT; submissions after that will be retro.
Derek S.: For PTO accrual, we don't change accrual rates mid-cycle for promotions unless employee moves to a different accrual policy. Confirm current accrual policy remains.
Lena R.: Also note: if promotion effective date falls within a pay period we may need retro calculations for holiday / PTO usage. PayrollTeam, is there anything else?
PayrollTeam: Confirmed - if effective 2025-06-01 and form filed by 2025-05-23 cutoff, no retro. If late, Payroll will run backpay; allow up to 2 pay cycles. Also: any one-time payments (retention/bonus) already scheduled will be paid as-is unless reauthorized.
Priya M.: Who signs the equity memo for >2.5%?
compops-bot: Escalation path: CompOps -> Head of People Ops -> CFO for >2.5% refresh. Provide market comp comps and performance summary.
Derek S.: Can we do a partial equity grant now and remainder at next refresh window to avoid exec signoff?
Lena R.: That's allowed in principle. CompOps will want the vesting schedule documented. Staggering can avoid escalation but requires documented justification.
Priya M.: Ok will draft memo with peer comps + performance highlights. Want to avoid retro. I'll upload form by 2025-05-20.
Priya M.: Upload done: <link-to-promo-packet>. Manager sign-off attached.
compops-bot: Received packet. Ticket #COPS-4599 created. Reviewing for comp band move and equity size. Expect decision within 48 hours.
Derek S.: Thanks. If compops requests calibration note, ping me and I'll write one.
PayrollTeam: Noted. We'll standby for final approved effective date and final salary.
Priya M.: Thanks all, will update after compops. :white_check_mark:
